claim: T1 item 7.analog evidence: a native `klt pex --measure-command` schematic-vs-extracted delta report over the whole composed sampler_core layout (layout/sampler_core/sampler_core.gds, 264 devices / 152 nets), 11 spec rows x 12 PVT corners (tt/ss/ff x 27C/1.8V, -40C/1.62V, -40C/1.98V, 125C/1.98V -- sim/post-layout-sampler-core/'s own four-point grid), both legs measured by the committed harness through `klt sim` corner requests on the batch fleet. 130/132 rows compare clean; the 2 non-pass rows are active_power_uw at ff/-40C/1.98V and ff/125C/1.98V, which fail the README Power target's 500 uW bound on BOTH legs (schematic 519.2/567.2 uW, extracted 585.3/602.6 uW) -- a pre-layout design condition parasitics add 6-13% to, not a parasitic-induced regression; bounded design-iteration follow-up is issue #604. Ring periods slow +116..+150% post-layout, consistent with sim/post-layout-sampler-core/'s committed same-deck control (~2.2x at -40C/1.62V). Simulation-derived; provisional until silicon.
author: loom-builder@sky130-trng
pex_invocation: klt pex layout/sampler_core/sampler_core.gds --deck sky130 --pdk sky130A --measure-command 'python3 sim/pex-sampler-core/harness/pex-measure.py' --reference-netlist design/sampler_core.spice --flatten-schematic --pins en1,en2,en3,en4,vddr1,vddr2,vddr3,vddr4,vdd,vss,clk,rst_n,raw_bit,raw_valid,ring_bit1,ring_bit2,ring_bit3,ring_bit4 --rename-declared-pins --backend batch --wait-for-capacity 600 --measure-timeout-s 7200

disclosures.extraction_model: first-order lumped-RC: one series R per net terminal (star), net-to-ground C for every net's own area/perimeter plus vertical-overlap coupling C unconditionally; NO lateral (same-layer sidewall) coupling (no --critical-net given); quasi-static, one frequency-independent R and C per net; no distributed RC ladder (no --distributed-rc). Verbatim in pex-report.json extraction.model.
disclosures.body_bias: biased -- every device body in the extracted netlist has a DC path (unbiased_device_count 0, no --tie-net needed).
disclosures.pdk: extraction resolved sky130A via the host search root (~/.ciel), open_pdks f6eeac7dad085ffcc829ccfd721f7b4ce39edcf7 -- NOT the volare install sim/pdk.json and design/pdk.json pin (c6d73a35f524...). Both legs of every delta row ran on the SAME fleet model library (models_lib_sha256 48de7c677e2c6e7d09b2559279de9f818be71010a4aa933d728eb4db3b133c84 in every resp-*.json), so each delta is self-consistent; absolute values carry this library pin, not the volare one.
disclosures.deck: curated sky130 deck content sha256:f78d2c3c9e92909b5baff6e00ece15a4158a55ca027a3ca20a96a7c6f10c0f42 on the klt 0.9.3.dev build (deck.released false -- dev build).
disclosures.measurement_mode: measure-command, not testbench: the spec rows read DUT-internal nets the extractor names with joined multi-label spelling no .meas card can quote on both legs; klt pex itself ran the committed harness once per side and computed every delta row (the harness never compares the two sides).
